name: Akane Rin
source:
The protagonist of Ayakashi Gohan if the player decides to play the routes in the "Childhood Chapters".

Akane Rin at 7-years-old. Since the death of her father, she has grown up being neglected by her freewheeling mother. She is shy and doesn't know the warmth a family can provide.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_rin.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
